newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n rates drop, forint firms vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n rates drop, forint firms vs dlr.

text.p: Hungary's overnight rates dropped below the one-week reverse repo rate of 21.75 percent on Tuesday, marking the consolidation of the market following the year-end's tight liquidity, dealers said.
Overnight rates closed at 21.625 percent after trading below 22 percent on Tuesday, compared with Monday's close of 23 percent.
"Funds from one-week reverse repo deals have returned, pushing the overnight market lower," said Europai Kereskedelmi Bank's Marton Kerekes.

The banks placed most of their excess funds in one-week or one-month reverse repo deals at the end of last year when the overnight rates were as low as 18 percent, causing a shortage of liquidity on the overnight money market early this year.
The overnight rates came down gradually from 26.50 percent on January 2, and may only find a resistance at 20 percent by the end of the banks' current reserve period next week, dealers said.
